defs.def: to feel certain that sth is true or that sb is telling you the truth 相信；认为真实

ex.s: Reisley believes that his devotion to the home and the community are what have kept him in such good health all of these years.
ex.t: Reisley相信，正是对这座房子和这片社区的热爱，让他多年来一直保持着如此好的健康状态。

ex.s: I walked into class believing that writing is important as a means of communication.
ex.t: 我走进教室，相信写作作为一种交流手段很重要。

ex.s: She believes she is here to serve.
ex.t: 与学长们的竞争。

ex.s: Mr Dena occasionally gave partner tests, believing that we could solve hard problems together.
ex.t: Dena先生偶尔会给合伙人做测试 认为我们可以一起解决难题

ex.s: I believe you are such a girl.”
ex.t: "我相信你就是这样的女孩。"

ex.s: At the end of the thirty days, you will then add back a small number of carefully chosen online activities that you believe will provide massive benefits to the things you value.
ex.t: 在这三十天结束时，你再重新加入少量精心挑选的线上活动，这些活动你认为会为你所看重的事物带来巨大益处。

ex.s: Continued developments in communication technologies were once believed to make the printed page outdated.
ex.t: 通信技术的不断发展曾让人们以为印刷书页将会过时。

ex.s: Cao believes this will make the hiking trip even more ___66___ (meaning).
ex.t: 曹相信这将使徒步旅行更加___66___ (meaning)有意义。

ex.s: If you believe you have received the email in error, email the PASS office at  passoffice@umbs. edu..
ex.t: 如果你认为收到邮件有误，请发邮件至passoffice@umbs.edu..

ex.s: The researchers believe that the findings could help technology companies develop better machines that use air to do their jobs, as suction has long been used in robotics to grab objects.
ex.t: 研究人员认为这些发现可以帮助技术公司开发更好的利用空气工作的机器，因为吸力长期以来一直被用于机器人技术来抓取物体。

ex.s: Some people--and I was one of them--believe that humorous complaints about the little problems of life make humor, and sometimes that is the case.
ex.t: 有些人 -- 我也是其中之一 -- 相信幽默的抱怨 生活的小问题 使幽默,有时就是这样。

ex.s: I couldn't quite believe my _____53_____ it turned out no one got badly hurt, but the outcome could have been _____54_____ .Don was given a special _____55_____ that night—I didn’t want him thinking I was angry with him.
ex.t: 我简直不敢相信我的_____53_____——结果没人受重伤，但后果本可能_____54___。那天晚上唐得到了特别的_____55_____——我不想让他以为我在生他的气。

ex.s: My grandmother helped me believe that I could accomplish ______ I put my mind to.
ex.t: 我祖母帮助我相信只要我用心去做我就能完成______任何事情。

ex.s: The lady would get a call from a stranger every morning who   20   made her believe that he was her friend, and then she lent him about £3I,000 Jones was  21 when she said that she didn't actually   22   being cheated, “Otherwise, I would never speak to another person for weeks on end,” she said.

ex.s: I believe this was a perfect   29   for a child in losing something important…to lose it and feel the full   30   of that loss, and then to miraculously get it back.
ex.t: 我相信，对于一个孩子来说，这是失去重要之物的完美___29___……失去它，感受那份失去的全部___30___，然后奇迹般地失而复得。

ex.s: Her final goal is to link the worlds of art and science back together: She believes that bringing the old recipes to life can help develop a kind of learning that highlights experimentation, teamwork, and problem solving.
ex.t: 她的最终目标是把艺术与科学这两个世界重新联系起来：她相信，让古老配方“活”起来，有助于发展一种强调实验、团队合作和解决问题的学习方式。

ex.s: “If we're successful,” their mission statement reads, “we believe this will be one of the most important and widely beneficial scientific advances ever made.”
ex.t: "如果我们成功的话，"他们的使命声明写道，"我们相信这将是迄今为止最重要、最有益的科学进步之一。"

ex.s: Instead, I agree with Oxford University philosopher Nick Bostrom, who believes that the heaviest risks from A GI do not come from a decision to turn against mankind but rather from a dogged pursuit of set objectives at the expense of everything else.

ex.s: They tend to believe in themselves and in what they do.
ex.t: 他们倾向于相信自己以及自己所做的事情。

ex.s: Most people believe the best way to build a great team is to gather a group of the most talented individuals.
ex.t: 这个小型团体自行车游是欣赏华盛顿特区世界著名樱花树美景的绝佳方式。

ex.s: Dunn believes that people who reach out to strangers feel a significantly greater sense of belonging, a bond with others.
ex.t: 邓恩认为，主动与陌生人接触的人会感到明显更强的归属感，一种与他人之间的纽带。

ex.s: Carducci believes developing such a sense of belonging starts with small talk.
ex.t: Carducci 认为，培养这种归属感始于闲聊。

ex.s: I still can’t believe what a   59   it was.
ex.t: 我仍不敢相信那是多么___59___的事。

ex.s: Wang believes traditions should not be sealed in glass boxes at museums.
ex.t: 王认为传统不应被密封在博物馆的玻璃箱里。

ex.s: While 78 percent of parents said they believed they were good screen time role models, the study found a disconnect between their behavior and their perception of their behavior.
ex.t: 虽然78%的父母说他们相信自己是有良好屏幕时间榜样的人，但研究发现他们的行为与他们对自身行为的认知之间存在脱节。

ex.s: Believe it or not
ex.t: 信不信由你

ex.s: Mr Anderson said: “I couldn’t believe that the guy never took a penny.
ex.t: 安德森先生说：“我不敢相信那家伙一分钱都没拿。”

ex.s: I can't believe the first week is coming to an end.
ex.t: 我简直不敢相信第一周就要结束了。

ex.s: Opinions can sometimes be identified by the presence of words such as "feel", "believe" and "think".
ex.t: 观点有时可以通过"feel"、"believe"和"think"等词的存在来识别。

ex.s: Many people who saw the film started to believe that sharks were bad animals that ate humans.
ex.t: 许多看过这部电影的人开始相信鲨鱼是吃人的坏动物。

ex.s: People who saw the file Jaws believed 2______.
ex.t: 看过电影《大白鲨》的人相信2______。

ex.s: You believe travel is about broadening your mind and growing as a person.
ex.t: 你相信旅行是为了开阔视野，让自己成长为更好的人。

ex.s: But Bonds doesn't believe a robot is right for the job.
ex.t: 多年的行业经验——以及使用技术的失败尝试——使他相信检查牛群的最好方式是让人骑在马上进行。

ex.s: I always wanted to know what my mom was reading． Hearing mom say，"I can't believe what's printed in the newspaper this morning，" made me want to grab it out of her hands and read it myself． I wanted to be like my mom and know all of the things she knew． So I carried around a book， and each night， just to be like her， I would pretend to be reading．
ex.t: 我一直想知道妈妈在读什么。听到妈妈说“真不敢相信今天早上报纸上印了什么”，我就想从她手里抢过报纸自己读。我想成为像妈妈那样的人，知道她知道的所有事情。于是我随身带着一本书，每天晚上，就为了像她一样，我还会假装在阅读。

defs.def: to think that sth is true or possible, although you are not completely certain 把（某事）当真；认为有可能

ex.s: We can't appreciate these kinds of details without seeing works of art as they originally appeared-something Smith believes you can do only when you have a road map.
ex.t: 如果不把这些艺术品按最初的样子来看，我们就无法欣赏此类细节——史密斯认为，只有当你有一张“路线图”时才能做到这一点。

ex.s: Often students come to the classroom believing that learning can’t be fun and that what they learn isn’t relevant to the real world — much less to their personal interests.
ex.t: 学生们常常带着这样的看法走进教室：学习不可能有趣，所学内容与现实世界无关——更谈不上与他们的个人兴趣有关。

ex.s: He believes bus drivers are the eyes and ears of students when they're away from home and they have a gift to discern what kids are feeling.
ex.t: 他认为，当学生们离家在外时，公交车司机就是他们的眼睛和耳朵，并且他们有一种辨别孩子们感受的天赋。

ex.s: Indeed, when it comes to environmental transformations, we can develop a form of collective “poor memory”, and each new generation can believe the state of affairs they encounter is nothing out of the ordinary.
ex.t: 的确，在环境变化方面，我们会产生一种集体的"健忘"，每一代新人都可能认为他们所遇到的事态再正常不过。

ex.s: It is believed that today's children and teenagers are consuming three times the recommended level of sugar, putting them at a higher risk of the disease.
ex.t: 据信，如今的儿童和青少年摄入的糖是建议量的三倍，使他们患该病的风险更高。

ex.s: In recent years some Inuit people in Nunayut   65   (report) increases in bear sightings around human settlements, leading to a   66   (believe) that populations are increasing.
ex.t: 近年来，努纳武特的一些因纽特人___65___（report）在人类聚居地附近看到熊的次数增加，导致一种种群在增长的___66___（believe）。

ex.s: Some language experts believe that 10,000 years ago, when the world had just five to ten million people, they spoke perhaps 12,000 languages between them.
ex.t: 一些语言专家认为，一万年前，当世界只有五百到一千万人时，他们之间可能讲着一万两千种语言。
